name: Wiki-js
description: Wiki with a visual and Markdown editor, search and Git sync

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with every page, file and user, and secrets.env with this install's own database password. Back it up.

paths.name: Content
paths.description: Pages saved by the Local Disk storage target, when you turn it on.

paths.name: Repo
paths.description: The local copy of the Git repository, when you turn on Git sync.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Wiki.js web UI, published on host as 6760

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: The email you sign in with as the first admin. Only used on the very first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASS
variables.description: The first admin's password. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used on the very first start; change it later in Wiki.js itself.
